mapper.sql: h.user_pet_tag_history_id, h.pet_id, h.used_at, p.mention_id, p.name, p.user_no AS ownerUserNo, u.nickname AS ownerNickname, p.profile_file_id
mapper.select: SELECT FROM ultary_user_pet_tag_history h INNER JOIN ultary_pet p ON p.pet_id = h.pet_id AND p.is_deleted = 0 INNER JOIN ultary_user u ON u.user_no = p.user_no AND u.withdrawal_status = 'ACTIVE' WHERE h.user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM ultary_user_block b WHERE b.is_deleted = 0 AND ( (b.blocker_user_no = #{viewerUserNo} AND b.blocked_user_no = p.user_no) OR (b.blocker_user_no = p.user_no AND b.blocked_user_no = #{viewerUserNo}) ) ) ORDER BY h.used_at DESC, h.user_pet_tag_history_id DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ultary_user_pet_tag_history ( user_no, pet_id, used_at ) VALUES ( #{userNo}, #{petId}, NOW() ) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE used_at = NOW()
